summary: READY. The fix2 design is compatible with the five retained findings and the frozen remote lifecycle contract. Builder release needs only the representation pins below; they clarify existing requirements and add no policy.
required_pins: Each private P/E/H/H2 pending image must bind its field, original token, parent, exact remote finalization identity, relevant source/proof identities, generation inputs, owned paths, exact before bytes, expected modes, and regenerated after hashes under one identified descriptor.

Fresh-process regeneration must use retained remote integration gates/review/verification/finalization and retained source receipt bytes. It must not call the local T05L historical-finalization resolver, recompute historical environment hashes, rerun analysis, or obtain a fresh timestamp.

E must retain closed_at and the exact before-story; H/H2 must retain handoff_at and next. Resume uses those saved values and proves regenerated bytes/hash equal the descriptor before examining or writing the checkout.

The rendering view should be constructed from the frozen M/finalization/source fields used by the formatter, excluding mutable record revision, updated_at and later provider-attempt state. The existing immutable-source-C validation may remain; it is an established source identity check rather than historical environment recomputation.

Once any closure artifact is pending or adopted, remote evidence replacement must refuse. Otherwise a later gate/review/finalization could strand or silently change the generation basis that closure was required to name.

Recovery must first prove checkout branch, parent, protected proof and ordinary index, then require porcelain status to contain only owned pending paths and every owned path to equal its retained before or after image. Refusal performs no writes. Exact recovery reapplies only retained after-images and returns the original token.
premerge_and_provider_ruling: For merge, squash and rebase, N is the valid OID from the effect-bound merge attempt’s identified premerge observation. N must descend from approved I and be available in the fetched proof repository; a later provider base that was not observed and bound remains LINEAGE_UNPROVEN.
Merge [N,C], squash parent N with the exact recomputed N+C tree and unique bounded source delta, and rebase’s complete bounded first-parent range from N are supported by the frozen contract.
Do not add a rebase commit-count or nonempty-commit rule. A path-bounded empty commit is not independently forbidden when ancestry, range bound, authorized net delta and exact final tree all hold.

Supersession remains limited to an unmerged attempt with an identified qualifying prior/current observation and an actual head or base change. READY and exact HEAD_MISMATCH may qualify; draft, pending, failed, absent and unknown observations remain read-only. Expected C stays immutable.
A present null or malformed remoteBase is unproved and must not fall back. Only an omitted property permits the bounded Git observation.

An observed non-effect attempt remains terminal and retained. Repeating identical input must return its projected result without allocating another write; only qualified supersession may create the successor. Merge-pending never proves absence or authorizes replay.

Provider transition validation may reject malformed chains, deletion/rebinding, illegal replay and inconsistent active/disposition/effect links. It must continue accepting the approved prepared→executing→observed chain and the same-token, same-process ended plus exact-absence replay chain.
